test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: As per the Economic Survey 2025-26, the Centre’s revenue receipts strengthened from an average of about 8.5 per cent of GDP in FY16–FY20 to what percentage of GDP in FY25 (PA)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**9.2 per cent.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Union Minister for Finance and Corporate Affairs Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman tabled the Economic Survey 2025-26 in Parliament.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Economic Survey highlights that the **Centre’s revenue receipts** strengthened from an average of about 8.5 per cent of GDP in FY16–FY20 to **9.2 per cent of GDP in FY25 (PA)**.
 
• This improvement was driven by buoyant **non-corporate tax collections**.
 
• Non-corporate tax collections rose from about 2.4 per cent of GDP pre-pandemic to around 3.3 per cent post-pandemic.
 
• The survey attributes this to improved compliance, greater use of technology in tax administration, and a growing number of individuals entering the tax net.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Other Fiscal Indicators__

 
 
• **Income Tax Returns Filed:** Increased from 6.9 crore in FY22 to **9.2 crore** in FY25.
 
• **Gross GST Collections (April-Dec 2025):** ₹17.4 lakh crore (6.7% YoY growth).
